message.content: Both claims target tolerance violations in different input regions and neither's probe design depends on the other, so I'll launch both probes together. Each will sweep the full legal FP16 domain against the FP64 reference, with c1 focusing the worst-case report on the k=0 max-|r| region and c2 on the large-positive region.

function.arguments:
{"claim_id": "c1", "code": "import sys, json, numpy as np, torch
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_97")
import kernel

# All distinct finite FP16 values in [-10,10]
vals = torch.tensor(np.arange(65536, dtype=np.uint16).view(np.float16), dtype=torch.float16)
vals = vals[torch.isfinite(vals) & (vals.abs() <= 10.0)]
x = vals.to("cuda")
out = kernel.run(x)
ref = kernel.reference(x.cpu()).to("cuda")
err = (out.double() - ref.double()).abs()
tol = 1e-7 + 1e-6 * ref.double().abs()

# c1 focus: k=0 region, |x| just under ln2/2 (~0.3466)
ln2_2 = 0.6931471805599453 / 2
mask0 = ((x.abs() <= ln2_2 + 1e-4) & (x.abs() >= 0.3))
viol = err > tol
worst_idx = int(torch.argmax(torch.where(mask0, err / tol, torch.zeros_like(err))))
xw = float(x[worst_idx])
print(json.dumps({
    "metric": "abs err vs 1e-7+1e-6*|target| over all 9000+ legal FP16 values, focus k=0 max|r| region",
    "n_legal_fp16_values": int(x.numel()),
    "k0_region_violations": int((viol & mask0).sum()),
    "total_violations": int(viol.sum()),
    "worst_k0_region": {"x": xw, "err": float(err[worst_idx]), "tol": float(tol[worst_idx]), "ratio": float(err[worst_idx]/tol[worst_idx])},
    "global_worst_ratio": float((err/tol).max()),
    "global_worst_x": float(x[int(torch.argmax(err/tol))]),
}))", "expected_signal": "whether any k=0 region input violates the tolerance", "timeout_s": 300}

import kernel

vals = torch.tensor(np.arange(65536, dtype=np.uint16).view(np.float16), dtype=torch.float16)
vals = vals[torch.isfinite(vals) & (vals.abs() <= 10.0)]
x = vals.to("cuda")
out = kernel.run(x)
ref = kernel.reference(x.cpu()).to("cuda")
err = (out.double() - ref.double()).abs()
tol = 1e-7 + 1e-6 * ref.double().abs()

# c2 focus: large positive inputs, k=14, x >= 9.0
mask = x >= 9.0
viol = err > tol
sub = err[mask] / tol[mask]
i = 0
xlist = x[mask].cpu()
worst = int(torch.argmax(sub)) if sub.numel() else 0
print(json.dumps({

    "total_violations_all_legal": int(viol.sum()),
    "worst_x_geq_9": {"x": float(xlist[worst]), "err": float(err[mask][worst]), "tol": float(tol[mask][worst]), "ratio": float(sub[worst])},
    "x_plus_10": {"err": float(err[x == 10.0]), "tol": float(tol[x == 10.0]), "ratio": float(err[x == 10.0]/tol[x == 10.0])},
}))", "expected_signal": "whether x=+10 / k=14 inputs violate the tolerance", "timeout_s": 300}
